clue.text: Sound measure?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to sound or get to the bottom of, as a verb
second meaning: a unit of six feet used for the depth of water

explanation.walkthrough: The two words read as one phrase, a measure of sound, but they are two separate meanings of the same word.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a verb for probing depth or understanding fully and a nautical unit of length.

clue.text: Setting bail, one defence that might be offered

indicators.note: setting, like setting type or a jewel, means arranging, so the letters are put in a new order

parts.note: the Roman numeral I is one

explanation.surface: A lawyer arranging bail mentions a line of defence the accused might use.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Setting bail' sounds like a court procedure, which fits the legal surface, but 'Setting' is the instruction to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: A claim that one was elsewhere when the crime happened is a standard plea offered in court.

clue.text: Put up with song beginning to note language

parts.note: pictures put up on a wall are hung
an aria is a song in an opera

indicators.note: the beginning to a word is its first letter, here of note

explanation.surface: Someone tolerates a song that starts with a single note, then turns to talk of language.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the tongue spoken in Hungary, also called Magyar, a member of the Finno-Ugric family.

clue.text: Mike is suitable and eccentric

parts.note: Mike is M in the NATO phonetic alphabet
something suitable is fit for the purpose

explanation.surface: A description of a man called Mike: well suited to things, yet odd.
explanation.definitionFit: An eccentric, as a noun, is an oddball who does not fit in with others.

clue.text: Suffer embarrassment as she will do when only he remains?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to be humiliated publicly

definitions.text: she will do when only he remains
definitions.meaning: second meaning, read cryptically: the word she drops its front letter S and leaves he

explanation.walkthrough: The second half reads like a widow's lot, but 'face' means the front of the word she: remove its S and he is all that remains.
explanation.definitionFit: To be humiliated and lose others' respect is the idiom for losing one's standing or dignity.

clue.text: Party concentrated, needing a lot of workers

parts.note: Labour is a major UK political party
intensive effort is concentrated effort

explanation.surface: A political party focuses hard on its staffing needs.
explanation.definitionFit: Industries such as farming that require many hands relative to capital are described this way.

clue.text: Still surviving on board ship, they may be needed

definitions.text: Still surviving on board ship, they may be needed

indicators.note: being on board a vessel means sitting inside it, so these letters go within the ship's letters

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for steamship
extant means still in existence

explanation.surface: Old navigation instruments, still in use aboard ships, may yet be required.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue doubles as the definition: these navigation instruments are still found on ships in case electronics fail.
explanation.definitionFit: Navigators carry these angle-measuring instruments for finding position by the sun and stars.

clue.text: Lie about strength of character

parts.note: a fib is a small lie
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: Someone tells untruths regarding their own moral courage.
explanation.definitionFit: Moral fibre is backbone or toughness of character, so the word alone can stand for it.

clue.text: Charlie isn't hers — changed names

parts.note: Charlie is C in the NATO phonetic alphabet

indicators.note: changed means altered, so the letters of these two words are reordered

explanation.surface: A child called Charlie is not hers after all, so his names are changed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'changed' rearranges ISNTHERS into HRISTENS, placed after C for Charlie.
explanation.definitionFit: To give a baby its name at baptism is the ceremonial sense of naming a child.

clue.text: It's news about fight for place in court

indicators.note: about can mean in a jumble or roundabout way, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: to box is to fight with fists

explanation.surface: A news report about a boxing match.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the enclosure in a British courtroom where people stand to give evidence; Americans say stand.

clue.text: Stood up to drill

definitions.meaning: first meaning: endured, the past tense of bear
second meaning: to make a hole, as a drill does

explanation.walkthrough: 'Stood up to drill' reads like soldiers ready for exercises, but it is two meanings side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is the past tense of bear, meaning endured, and also a verb for boring a hole.

clue.text: I squeeze into new suit for dessert

indicators.note: into means going inside, so these letters sit within the others
new means made afresh, so the letters of suit are rearranged

parts.note: to ram is to force or squeeze in

explanation.surface: Someone forces themselves into a new suit after eating pudding.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged suit letters are split after their first letter to take the inserted part.
explanation.definitionFit: An Italian layered pudding of coffee-soaked sponge and mascarpone, served at the end of a meal.

clue.text: Reluctant to say she has no heart

parts.note: to aver is to declare or say

indicators.note: losing the heart means the middle letter is gone, leaving only the outside letters of she

explanation.surface: Someone hesitates to say that a woman is heartless.
explanation.definitionFit: Being opposed to or unwilling to do something is a close synonym of disinclined.

clue.text: Imagined being still single

parts.note: yet means still, as in still to come
the Roman numeral I is one, a single unit

explanation.surface: Someone fancied they were still unmarried.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Imagined' looks like a verb and 'being' like a link, but together they are a noun phrase for a mythical creature.
explanation.definitionFit: The abominable snowman of the Himalayas is a legendary creature that may exist only in fancy.

clue.text: Develop complex

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to expand on in detail, as a verb
second meaning: intricate, as an adjective

explanation.walkthrough: 'Develop complex' reads like a psychological diagnosis, but it is a verb and an adjective spelt the same way.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to add detail to an idea; as an adjective it describes something detailed and intricate.

clue.text: Point here duly covers state of bank account

indicators.note: the outer words cover or conceal the answer running across them

explanation.surface: A bank statement whose point duly shows the state of the account.
explanation.definitionFit: Being overdrawn, with a debit balance, is described by this phrase from the red ink once used for debts.

clue.text: Appearance of endless crisis on energy

indicators.note: endless means lacking its final letter

parts.note: an emergency is a crisis
E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: A never-ending crisis shows up on top of an energy shortage.
explanation.definitionFit: Coming out into view is the act of surfacing or coming forth, a synonym of appearance.

clue.text: Loyal worker supporting Tory way

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting means placed below the rest

parts.note: CON is short for Conservative, the Tory party
ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
the ant is the crossword's standard worker

explanation.surface: A faithful employee backs the Conservative approach.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone steadfast and faithful in affection or allegiance is described this way.

clue.text: Gear requiring cam to be reversed

definitions.text: Gear requiring cam to be reversed

parts.words: Gear requiring cam to be reversed
parts.note: reads like engineering, but the gear is clothing and the word cam written backwards names it

explanation.walkthrough: The engineering surface of gears and cams misleads: cam written backwards is MAC, short for mackintosh, which is this garment.
explanation.definitionFit: A mac or mackintosh is waterproof outerwear, and gear here means clothing.

clue.text: Comfortable feeling sick? No question

indicators.note: no here means without, so the following letters are removed

parts.note: queasy means nauseous

explanation.surface: A doctor asks whether the patient is comfortable or feeling sick, and the answer is not in doubt.
explanation.definitionFit: Being relaxed and free from worry or pain is a synonym of being at ease.

clue.text: When keeping cover, reportedly is of use

indicators.note: reportedly signals what is heard rather than written

parts.note: as means when, and it keeps (holds inside) veil, a cover, giving a word said like the answer

explanation.surface: Holding on to a cover turns out to be useful, so people say.
explanation.walkthrough: AS (when) keeping VEIL (cover) gives AVEILS, which said aloud matches the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To be of benefit or help is the verb sense of the word, as in it avails nothing.

clue.text: Warnings about Conservative powers

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so these letters go around the inserted one

parts.note: fore is the golfer's shouted warning

explanation.surface: Warnings issued about the Conservatives' powers.
explanation.definitionFit: Strengths or energies acting on something are physical powers, a near synonym.

clue.text: Dance clubs dealing with gear regularly going missing

parts.note: C is the card-suit abbreviation for clubs
on means about or dealing with, as in a book on birds

indicators.note: letters going missing at regular intervals leaves every other letter of gear

explanation.surface: Nightclubs selling gear, with some of it regularly disappearing on the dance floor.
explanation.definitionFit: A Latin American line dance in which people follow one another, kicking on every fourth beat.

clue.text: Negotiate access by retired Russian

indicators.note: retired means withdrawn or going back, so the name is written backwards

parts.note: Ivan is a typical Russian man's name
a gate gives access

explanation.surface: A retired Russian bargains for entry.
explanation.definitionFit: To negotiate a route or obstacle is to steer a way through it, a synonym of the answer.

clue.text: House party in northern part of Turkey

indicators.note: in here means the party is held within the Turkish letters, so those go around it

parts.note: in a down clue the northern part is the top, the first three letters of Turkey
a do is a party

explanation.surface: A house party held in the north of Turkey.
explanation.definitionFit: The royal dynasty of Henry VIII and Elizabeth I; house here means a ruling family.

clue.text: Nessie originally seen on salt lake

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means placed after the other part

parts.note: an old salt and a tar are both sailors

indicators.note: originally means the first letter of Nessie

explanation.surface: The Loch Ness monster is first spotted on a salt lake.
explanation.definitionFit: A small mountain lake, especially in the north of England, is called by this word.

clue.text: Fan may see trouble following a lie having lost heart

indicators.note: following means coming after the earlier pieces
losing the heart means the middle letter of the seven-letter word goes

parts.note: a fiction is a made-up story, a lie
ado is fuss or trouble

explanation.surface: A supporter is in trouble after telling a lie and losing courage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'may see' is only a link; the heart of the seven-letter lie is its single middle letter.
explanation.definitionFit: An ardent enthusiast or devotee of a pastime is a fan, from the Spanish word for a bullfight follower.

clue.text: Banter about involvement with drugs

parts.note: re means about or concerning
having a part in something is involvement
E is slang for ecstasy, so two Es are drugs

explanation.surface: Jokey chatter about someone's involvement with drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: Quick witty conversational exchanges are the essence of both words.

clue.text: Reluctant to admit mistake getting wine

indicators.note: to admit is to let in, so these letters go inside

parts.note: shy means reluctant, as in shy of doing something
to err is to make a mistake

explanation.surface: Someone loath to confess an error reaches for a glass of wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A fortified wine from around Jerez in southern Spain.
